Competitive analysis — how we do it

Every analysis opens with a Verdict section: one paragraph, the decision it supports, written last.
Include a Competitors section that profiles each competitor on the same five criteria: price, target customer, strongest feature, weakest point, and momentum.
Include a table with the columns Company, Price, Target customer, Strength, Weakness.
Every figure must come from the sources provided, never from memory.
Weigh switching costs for the customer before recommending anything.
Call out where our own product loses, plainly.
Include a Pricing section comparing list prices per seat.
End with a Risks section, then the recommendation.
Keep it under two pages.
